# EPUB SUB Hamburg

> A digital library repository at the University of Hamburg featuring browse and discovery capabilities organized by multiple international classification systems.

EPUB SUB Hamburg is the digital publication platform of the Staats- und Universitätsbibliothek Hamburg (SUB HH). It provides access to digital documents and academic materials organized through standardized subject classification schemes, enabling researchers and students to discover content across multiple disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Dewey Decimal Classification (DDC)
- Digital Library
- Subject Organization
- Metadata Discovery
- Document Browsing
- Mathematics Subject Classification (MSC)
- Physics and Astronomy Classification Scheme (PACS)
- Computing Classification System (CSS)
- Journal of Economic Literature (JEL)
- Academic Repository
- Classification Systems
- Subject Browsing
- University of Hamburg

## Document Discovery & Browsing

- [Browsing-Möglichkeiten](https://epub.sub.uni-hamburg.de/epub/browsen_uebersicht.php): Browse digital library documents using DDC and classification systems
